text.en: This Order may be cited as the Legal Profession Act (Amendment) Order,
Section 20 of the Legal Profession Act, in this Order referred to as the Act, is amended, in subsection (I), by deleting paragraph (el. Insertion of new section 20A

The Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after 18 and 19 not to extend to arbitration proceedings 20A. (1) Sections 18 and 19 shall not extend to -

(a) any arbitrator or umpire lawfully acting in any arbitration

(b) any person representing any party in arbitration proceedings; or

(c) the giving of advice, preparation of documents and any other assistance in relation to or arising out of arbitration proceedings except for the right of audience in court proceedings.

(2) In this section, "arbitration proceedings" means proceedings in an arbitration which -

(a) is governed by the Arbitration Order, 2009 (S 3412009) or the International Arbitration Order, 2009 (S 3512009); or

(b) would have been governed by either the Arbitration Order, 2009 (S 3412009) or the International Arbitration Order, 2009 (S 3512009) had the place of arbitration been Brunei Darussalam.". Made this 7th. day of Muharram, 1438 Hijriah corresponding to the 8th. day of October, 2016 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
